_comment: features/api/trading/trade_fixings.feature. The recording is the online fixings response (GET /trades/{id}/fixings/online): data.fixings.* keeps the fixing sources a product has (two for FX_CO), each any array, as its dates grow with today. A product whose fixing dates are all in the future returns {}: its byProduct gives "dynamicFields": { "data.fixings.*": null }. request.fixingDates (read by 'every fixing date up to today has a value', never sent: the case sends no body): the response path of the product's fixing dates in the retrieved trade, when not tradeDetailsSchedule["Fixing Date"]

FX_TRF._comment: No tradeDetailsSchedule: the reset dates of the instrument's schedule
